_doc: Visual style table: internal taxonomy for sample generation. The first 15 ids come from tools/spread/art_taxonomy.py (palette and name are read from there); the rest extend it with digital-culture and electronic-music-adjacent movements. 'sources' / 'fx' / 'comp' are node pools; 'ban' keeps nodes out; motion 0..1 is how much the picture moves; 'pairs' lists music style ids that fit when the sample has sound. Research in docs/plans/patch-corpus/taxonomy/art.md.
